correctness.rationale: Algebra of response tilt yields r_b(v)=1+(q_b-p)s_eta(v), s_eta=(pi_eta-p)/(p(1-p)). Symmetry of uniform V makes d_eta even and s_eta(v)=3 eta v+O(eta^2) uniformly. Therefore E s_eta^2=3 eta^2+O(eta^3) and E Vs_eta=eta+O(eta^2); KL and Fisher coefficients follow by Taylor expansion, plus target mean. The bounded triangular log likelihood increments prove Gaussian LLR limit when m eta^2->lambda; Pinsker and Hoeffding respectively cover vanishing/diverging regimes. Scope is known-source fixed p, b0!=b1, eta down zero.
